With Tamara, get everything you want...when you want it! Shop and split your payments into 3 payments, interest-free and hassle-free.

Buy what you want without breaking the bank: pay 30 days later or split into 3 easy payments.
No interest, No hidden fees, No forms to fill
Split into 3 installments: 100-1500 SAR
Split into 6 installments: 1500-3000 SAR

How do I use Tamara. It’s simple - you’ll be there in 3 quick steps!
Check out via Tamara: Shop and split your payments in 3 with Tamara. It’s completely interest- and hassle-free!
Make your first payment: Log in with your mobile number, pay for a third of your order, and split the remaining amount in two payments over 60 days.
And you’re done! Enjoy your order! Download the Tamara app to keep track of your payment plans and explore our stores and offers.

• Minimum transaction amount to convert to EPP is SAR 1,000 per transaction.
